title: Pix key claim status changed
description: Pix key claim creation and/or status change. The following endpoints generate this event: Create key claim, Cancel key claim, and Complete key claim. For more information, see the Pix instant payments guide. Also see the Pix payments data events guide.

correlation_id.title: Correlation ID
correlation_id.description: Use this attribute when provider returns timeout on claim creation. The correlation ID (CID) informed on the claim API creation request and events. The CID can help the Pismo engineering team track everything related to a call. You can find the CID field in the response header from an API endpoint call

key.title: Pix key value
key.description: Pix key value of key type. For example: someguy@gmail.com (`EMAIL` key type)

key_type.title: Pix key type
key_type.description:
Pix key type:
`CPF` - Cadastro de Pessoas Fisicas (Indiviual Taxpayer Registry) number. Similar to a Social Security number in the US.
`CNPJ` - Cadastro Nacional de Pessoa Juridica (National Registry of Legal Entities) number. Unique ID for legal entities, such as companies and organizations, in Brazil
`EMAIL` - Email
`PHONE` - Phone number
`EVP` - Endereco de pagamento virtual (virtual payment address). A randomly-generated UUID number.

content_id.title: Content identifier
content_id.description: Content ID. This is a hashed value created from a number of key-related fields in the Pismo database. This is meant for you to store and send to Pismo in case there is any problem with the key.

cancel_reason.title: Claim cancel reason
cancel_reason.description: Claim cancellation reason. Will be null for non-cancelled claim

confirm_reason.title: Claim confirmation reason
confirm_reason.description: Claim confirmation reason. Will be null for non-confirmed claim

resolution_period_end.title: Resolution period end
resolution_period_end.description: Claim period end for the resolution. A RFC 3339 date-time value, i.e., '2023-04-12T23:20:50.52Z'.

completion_period_end.title: Completion period end
completion_period_end.description: Claim period end to be completed. Might be null for claim type `PORTABILITY`. A RFC 3339 date-time value, i.e., '2023-04-12T23:20:50.52Z'.

creation_datetime.title: Creation Time
creation_datetime.description: Claim creation datetime on the Pismo platform. A RFC 3339 date-time value, i.e., '2023-04-12T23:20:50.52Z'.

last_modified.title: Last modified
last_modified.description: Last modification datetime on the Pismo platform. A RFC 3339 date-time value, i.e., '2023-04-12T23:20:50.52Z'.

acknowledge_received_at.title: Acknowledge received
acknowledge_received_at.description: Acknowledge received on the Pismo platform. A RFC 3339 date-time value, i.e., '2023-04-12T23:20:50.52Z'.
